caption: The video showcases a close-up of a swirled candy lollipop in yellow, teal-blue, and white, mounted on a white stick against a dark, blurred background of stones. A blue glow sits at the right edge near the candy, where a green region is already glossy and partially melted. Over time, the green mass on the right becomes increasingly textured and foamy, changing shape while its lower tip droops at the right. A small green droplet briefly separates from that tip and drops out of view, while the blue glow shifts in brightness and form. The main swirled body, the stick, and the background surface stay largely in place.
